insights.insight: Ad tech charges $5–$150 CPA for probabilistic attribution; this protocol settles at ~$0.10 per cryptographically verified receipt — a 50–200x cost difference rooted in structure, not optimization. The receipt is the conversion event, eliminating the attribution problem entirely rather than solving it downstream.

insights.topic: Cookieless signal gap — receipts fill it
insights.insight: With Chrome completing third-party cookie deprecation, the industry's primary cross-site tracking primitive is gone; device fingerprinting is probabilistic and increasingly blocked; first-party data is accurate only within a single ecosystem. Verified email receipts are identity-free, cross-ecosystem, and cryptographically signed — none of the existing alternatives share all three properties.

insights.topic: Rural and non-metro coverage the ad stack can't reach
insights.insight: 17 active CBSAs in the current snapshot window span non-metro corridors across 21 states, with Southeast rural markets — FL, AL, NC, ME — activating simultaneously in the latest burst cycle. Urban-biased ad tech platforms have no comparable coverage infrastructure for these populations, and the diffusion pattern is accelerating, not plateauing.

insights.topic: Velocity breakout confirms sustained intake, not a spike
insights.insight: Token velocity has climbed from a 0.55–0.58x plateau to a current record of 0.839x, while the 14-day GMV window expanded from $77,064 to $79,670 in the latest cycle — confirming the acceleration is sustained intake, not a single large event exiting the rolling window.

insights.topic: High-value unknown merchant segment is a floor, not a ceiling
insights.insight: 125 receipts in the 'Unknown' category generated $16,654 in 14-day GMV — a $133 average basket, the highest of any category — because high-value merchants are failing name resolution despite the underlying receipt being cryptographically valid. Brand-level analysis is structurally undercounting the most valuable segment.

insights.topic: DTC digital commerce entering the verified receipt window
insights.insight: Shopify's appearance as a new brand entrant signals that direct-to-consumer digital merchants — distinct from both traditional retail and platform ecosystems — are now generating verified receipt signals alongside physical retail. The abstraction layer is holding across physical, platform, and DTC commerce simultaneously.
